'''Liuhuo''' is an [[NPC]] in [[Central Plains]], [[Huanglong]]. She can be found alongside [[Yujin]] near a [[Resonance Beacon]] close to the ''Parallel Perception'' [[Sonoro Sphere]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Liuhuo:''' They say the Central Plains is safe, but there are plenty of weirdos still lurking.
:{{DIcon}} Well, that's a bit strange.
:'''Liuhuo:''' Those sneaky [[Exiles]] broke into my supply chests and stole everything...
:'''Liuhuo:''' I was going to teach them a lesson, but then I ran into another suspicious folks.
:'''Liuhuo:''' Those [[Fractsidus|guys in red robes]], all mysterious, you can tell they're up to no good.
:'''Liuhuo:''' Who are these people, and what are they doing here?
:'''Liuhuo:''' Forget it... What lies in front of us is more important. If you see any Exiles, remember to let me know.
:'''Liuhuo:''' I'm gonna beat them until they're picking up their teeth off the ground, then take back our supplies.
:'''Liuhuo:''' Otherwise, the only choice for [[Yujin]] and I is to go hungry.
{{Dialogue End}}
